label: The shipped base composition mounts the skill registry, filesystem provider, and model-facing skill tool for local skill use.
DSH searches project .dsh/skills, project .agents/skills, custom, DSH_HOME, DSH_AGENTS_HOME, and optional bundled roots in priority order.
DSH requires name and description frontmatter and discovers only direct bundles or flat Markdown files, not nested recursive SKILL.md files; allowed-tools is not translated into tool permissions.
The nested shared skill tree must be flattened or linked one skill bundle per direct .dsh/skills entry to expose individual cli modes.
The filesystem provider follows per-entry symlinks and skips invalid frontmatter with warnings; it has no Hermes-like quarantine scanner.
Skill catalog descriptions are capped at 500 characters while loaded skill bodies have no size cap.
